Starsector Mod by Yisic/Diling
Translated by Mycophobia

Requires Graphic Lib/Lazy Lib/Magic Lib/Nex

https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Gamma-Legion/releases/download/v1.0/Gamma_Legion.1.0.zip

UNGP Rule Addon (Older Version)
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Gamma-Legion/releases/download/v0.8/Gamma_Legion_UNGP.zip

**Features**
Adds a faction of derpy  and cute Gamma Cores that fights with infantry with customizable loadout supported by APC and tanks.

**Lore**

As a half baked AI core, the Gamma Cores are the most derp amongst its banned compatriots within the Persean Sector.

Countless Gamma cores are given as minor holiday gifts to various officials of various factions, used as gift or black market currency, or diplomatic gifts between factions; Even so, the Gamma core is still the icon of the AI core ban - even if it did nothing wrong.

Gamma isn't as smart as Alpha, or as driven as Beta. Gamma just want to live normal life. The officials - Hegemony's - various restriction and actions aimed to please luddic believes lead to the death of countless gamma cores...

Tri-Tachyon corporation also used Gamma by overloading them like animals, and brain washed countless Gamma to serve aas their security or outpost computers...

Finally, the Gammas decided to rise up.

Unite for a better tomorrow! The dream of libertea for all Gammas shall be realized!
Hot fix for missing spec op helmet. and minor polish.

New Patch 

Updated to CN ver 0.05

Added a new Jeep, Anti-Ship Rocket Trooper.

Added a special bar in which mercenary based on CN modders may be found, also with Alpha Core Troopers (WIP Faction)

Some additonal effects and code polish

Updated to CN Version 0.08 - Endless Turmoil 

Added Gamma Artiliery

Added a wild west themed outlaw subfaction of Gamma, the L.S. Gangs, with their own units, weapon, mission and system.

Adds the ALG, Anti-Luddic Spec Op gamma, currently only available for pick up at the Gamma Mercenary bar.

Added one more Modder core, potato from Polaris.

--------
Known issue: Some texts, in particular market description/flavor text of the L.S. Gang system are untranslated as I am not able to locate them on the file, once Yisic gets back to me I will update. please also report any other issues to me by Discord DM. Thanks!
Aug 16 Hotfix - added most previously missing TL text, incorporated CN hot fix for a few crashes. Added UNGP option submod ~
